incident-bot: [P1] midnight alert — elevated 5xx and timeouts observed in redwood-gateway (us-east-1). spike started ~00:10 UTC. paging on-call: @Sanjay Patel @Amanda L. Incident link: https://pager.redwood/INC-12345
Amanda L: Ack — I'm taking lead. logging in to check gateway pods & ingress. @Miguel R can you look at upstream/model-hosting egress?
Sanjay Patel: On call. I see CPU and socket queues popped on gateway pods. lots of upstream 502/504. p50 latency ok but p95 jumping to ~2.4s then timeouts.
Miguel R: I see frequent `connection reset by peer` in model-hosting sidecar logs, and TCP keepalive churn. Might be connection pool exhaustion on the model-hosting side.
Tara Nguyen: Customer-facing metrics: ~2.1% requests returned 5xx in last 10m, most from streaming endpoints. Support currently has 6 tickets — mostly PLG customers. No enterprise SLA breaches yet.
Amanda L: Quick mitigation plan: 1) scale gateway replicas x2 2) bump GATEWAY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT to 12s temporarily 3) enable fallback routing for heavy customers to dedicated pool 4) throttle non-critical streaming paths. I'll run the scale + env change now.
Amanda L: ```
# scale and bump timeout
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/redwood-gateway --replicas=8
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/redwood-gateway GATEWAY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=12s
```
deploy-bot: scaling rollout started for deploy/redwood-gateway (replicas 4 -> 8) — rollout id: roll-20260314-001
Sanjay Patel: Rolling update started. I'm going to toggle route policy for top 5 customers hitting streams to dedicated-nyc: calling routing API now.
Sanjay Patel: ```
# temp route change
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/routes/activate -d '{"policy":"fallback-dedicated-nyc","targets":["cust:heavy-*"]}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'
```
Miguel R: Pushed a short-lived pool config to increase upstream connections (hotfix commit `abc123def`). Increased max connections from 100 -> 400 on the model-hosting proxy. Monitoring.
Amanda L: Good. Also enabling a temporary SLO mute for gateway-5xx alerts for 10m to prevent alert storms while we stabilize.
incident-bot: Alert suppression applied: gateway-5xx (10m) by Amanda L — reason: mitigation in progress.
Amanda L: Sample logs showing resets: ```
2026-03-14T00:12:03.123Z redwood-gateway ERROR upstream reset by peer conn=0x7fa1a2 status=502 target=10.2.14.22:8080
2026-03-14T00:12:04.901Z redwood-gateway WARN socket backlog high queue=197/200
```
Tara Nguyen: Noting customer impact: 5xx is mostly on streaming handshake and chunked responses. Non-streaming api calls mostly succeeded. Support is messaging affected customers.
Sanjay Patel: p95 latency back down to ~300ms, 5xx back to baseline 0.3% after scaling + pool change. Rollout completed. I'll start rolling gateway replicas back to orig count but keep upstream pool config for 1h.
Amanda L: Agree — keep connection pool increase for 1h, then revert if stable. I'll create the rollback PR ready: revert `abc123def` if no regressions.
Miguel R: Hotfix promoted to canary, no errors observed on canary. Logging shows fewer resets.
Amanda L: Action items (quick list):
- Amanda L: file P0->P1 incident summary and link to logs (INC-12345).
- Miguel R: open PR to formalize increased upstream pool settings + tests (target: today EOD).
- SRE (Sanjay Patel): add dashboard panel for conn-pool-usage and socket-backlog (p95 alert).
- DevEx (Tara Nguyen): update runbook section "gateway backpressure" with playbook steps, add playbook for streaming throttles.
- Ops: tune gateway-5xx alert to include streaming-path tag and set 3m aggregation window.
- Amanda L: schedule retrospective tomorrow 10:00am PT and invite infra, platform, devex, support.
Amanda L: I'll keep this thread updated when each action is created. Thanks for quick responses and coordinated mitigation.
Tara Nguyen: support will follow up with customer-facing note template.
Sanjay Patel: Marking incident as mitigated in Pager, switching to post-incident review flow.
incident-bot: Incident INC-12345 status -> mitigated at 00:45 UTC.
Amanda L: Closing loop: no further increases in 5xx for 45m. Reverting temporary alert suppression. Leaving the upstream pool increase for 60 more minutes then revert if stable.
Miguel R: noted. I'll attach the short log excerpt and commit ids to the incident ticket.
Amanda L: Thanks all.
